items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I saw Maxie telling Marshal to turn it up a little. And Marshal came up Brown

ctx.x: Yes. Well he's got this loud speaker over here by me, see. And one night I told Maxie about this. And one night I told, I saw Maxie telling Marshal to turn it up a little. And Marshal came up Brown, you know....
